# FG-REVIEW-0015

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `an_approval_past_the_cap_is_refused` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: このマージリクエストの承認の数が上限に達しています。既存の承認を確認してください。
- en: This merge request has reached the limit on approvals. Check the existing approvals.
- id: Merge request ini telah mencapai batas jumlah persetujuan. Periksa persetujuan yang ada.

## 原因 (cause)

An approval would make more than 50 live approvals on one merge request (M3 R5). The cap keeps the revocation of a new head within one change's 100 events (one `merge_request.unapproved` per approval) and the evaluation bounded; it is checked under the merge request's row lock. Nothing was written.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `reason=approvals_per_merge_request`, `limit`, `merge_request_id`. Count (read-only): SELECT count(*) FROM forge.merge_request_approvals WHERE merge_request_id = <id> AND revoked_at IS NULL.

## 対処 (fix)

Approvals beyond the rules' needs add nothing; ask approvers who are not needed to withdraw (`gstn mr unapprove`), or push a new commit (which clears the approvals).
